card.name: Be aware / keep in mind phrases
card.fires_on: The word completing a 'should be aware of' or 'should be kept/borne in mind' phrase in label warnings. It marks the point where the clinician is told to take note of something.

modes.label: be aware
modes.description: The word 'aware' after 'should be' or 'need to be', addressed to clinicians.
modes.example: Anesthesiologists should be<< aware>> of the potential for artifactual reduction

modes.label: keep in mind
modes.description: 'mind' or 'borne' in 'kept in mind' or 'borne in mind' after an effect is described.
modes.example: Intervention: This effect should be kept in<< mind>> when bleeding times are determined.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'note' or 'attention', such as 注意, eware and 注意事项.
card.plain: It lights up on the phrase that tells the reader to be aware of or keep something in mind.
